diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3.3 V, datasheet reading 4.75 V
diffs.evidence: The 4.75 V figure is the wiki working-voltage row written for a 5 V Seeeduino, but the board is passive (two pots and a push switch, no chip) and the Seeed product feature list for SKU 101020028, repeated by the reseller, states '5V/3.3V Compatible', so a 3.3 V minimum is correct and safer on 3.3 V MCUs, since a click puts VCC on X.
